name: coursecraft
description: Turn topics and source material into structured Markdown courses with connected lessons and optional practice.

interface.longDescription: Research a topic or work from your own sources, arrange a learning path, and write connected lessons. Export portable Markdown with source references, optional exercises, and quizzes, then study the material in your assistant.
defaultPrompt: Create a beginner course from a topic I want to learn.
Turn my documents into a practical onboarding course.
Quiz me on a course, one question at a time.
